property_summary: For any input _val and before initialization, calling SetMinSum(_val) sets C.MinSum equal to the provided _val; the mutant instead sets MinSum to block.timestamp for some fuzzed _val, so MinSum != _val (violating the rule) for values where _val != block.timestamp.
change_summary: Make SetMinSum set MinSum from block.timestamp instead of the provided parameter, changing the stored observable value.
